create_ParallelismConfig: create a ParallelismConfig to configure data, tensor, context, and sequence parallelism for distributed training
build_device_mesh: build a device mesh from a ParallelismConfig for torch distributed with configurable dp, tp, cp, and sp dimensions
get_device_mesh: get a cached device mesh from a ParallelismConfig, creating it lazily if not yet built
validate_ParallelismConfig: validate a ParallelismConfig against an Accelerator to ensure sizes match num_processes and distributed type is compatible
to_json_ParallelismConfig: serialize a ParallelismConfig to JSON, excluding non-serializable fields like device_mesh
